verdict.rationale: CoreWeave's object storage is S3-compatible (open standard) and infrastructure is managed via open Terraform/OpenTofu configs and standard kubeconfig/kubectl access, which support some data/infra portability, but there is no explicit documented 'export all your data' tool or account-exit workflow. missing for 10: a dedicated bulk data-export feature, documentation of exporting model weights/configs/billing history in open formats, and any statement about facilitating full account migration/leave.
